G2-273.title: Breakfast for Mom
G2-273.text: On Mother's Day, Oscar wakes up before everyone else. He tiptoes into the kitchen and makes toast with jam, the way Mom likes it. He pours a glass of orange juice and picks a flower from the yard. Oscar puts everything on a tray and carries it upstairs very slowly. When Mom opens her eyes, she smiles and gives him the biggest hug. Then they share the toast in bed.

G2-273.title: A Cake for Dad
G2-273.pageTitle: Reading Comprehension: A Cake for Dad
G2-273.text: It is Dad's birthday, and Nina wants to bake him a chocolate cake. Her big brother Max reads the recipe while Nina cracks the eggs. Oops! Some flour lands on the floor, and some lands on Nina's nose. With Mom's help, they put the cake in the oven and clean up fast. When Dad comes home, the whole house smells sweet. He laughs when he sees the flour still on Nina's nose.

G2-273.title: Grandma's Visit
G2-273.text: Grandma is coming to stay for a week, and she will sleep in Tessa's room. Tessa wants the room to feel special. She puts clean sheets on the bed and picks yellow flowers for a vase. Then she draws a picture of Grandma and tapes it above the bed. When Grandma walks in, she looks at the drawing for a long time. She says it will help her have sweet dreams.

G2-273.title: The Puzzle Present
G2-273.text: Yusuf's little sister Zara loves puzzles, and her birthday is in six weeks. Yusuf wants to buy her a puzzle with a hundred pieces. Every Saturday, he puts his coins in a jar on his shelf. Sometimes he wants to buy candy, but he keeps saving. At last, the jar is full, and he buys the puzzle. On her birthday, Zara hugs him and asks him to help her build it right away.

G2-273.title: Welcome Home, Dad
G2-273.text: Penny's dad has been away for work for two long weeks. Today he is coming home, and Penny has a plan. She and her mom blow up red balloons and hang them in the hall. Penny makes a big sign that says Welcome Home. When they hear the car, everyone hides behind the couch. Dad opens the door, and they all jump out and shout. Dad drops his bag and hugs them both.
